title: Migrate from MinIO
lead: Build a storage-cli command and read a local evidence file. Source credentials stay in your shell. This page does not send or store them.
commandHint: Keys are the environment variables below. Nothing on this form is saved on the server.
bucketsHint: Comma-separated. Empty copies every bucket the source key can list.
evidenceHint: Choose the evidence.json written by the command. It is read in the browser only.
evidenceBad: That file is not a migration evidence document.
